reports.title: Condensed Consolidated Interim Statements of Financial Position

guidance.heading: GUIDANCE
section: We continue to execute our 2026 plan and anticipate full year 2026 production of approximately 71,000 boe/d. Guidance for exploration and development expenditures, average royalty rate, operating expense, and transportation expense has been revised to reflect year-to-date results and our expectation for the fourth quarter.
The following table compares our 2026 revised annual guidance to our previously announced guidance and YTD 2026 results.

2026 Annual Guidance | Revised Annual Guidance | YTD 2026 Results
Exploration and development expenditures (1) | ~ $625 million | ~ $665 million | $453.7 million
Production (boe/d) (2) | ~ 71,000 | No change | 70,784
Average royalty rate (3)(4) | 15% | 16 | 15.8
Operating (3)(5) | $13.75 - $14.25/boe | $13.30/boe | $13.22/boe
Transportation (3)(5) | $3.40 - $3.60/boe | $3.75/boe | $3.73/boe
Leasing expenditures (3) | $7 million | No change | $6.4 million
Asset retirement obligations settled (3) | $20 million | No change | $9.1 million
